body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Kodak unveiled its newest Kodak Easyshare digital camera 'M530' at CES 2010.

It features 12MP, 3X Optical Zoom Lens, 2.7-inch bright LCD with KODAK Color Science technology, and more. The M530 will be available in red, green, blue, orange and carbon for US $129.95 MSRP beginning in February 2010.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
